import pandas as pd

def clean(df):
    # Make a copy of the dataframe to avoid modifying the original
    cleaned_df = df.copy()
    
    # Fix label variants in 'island' column
    cleaned_df['island'] = cleaned_df['island'].str.strip().str.title()
    
    # Convert 'body_mass_g' from text to numeric, handling commas
    cleaned_df['body_mass_g'] = cleaned_df['body_mass_g'].str.replace(',', '').astype(float)
    
    # Convert 'flipper_length_mm' to numeric and handle negatives/out-of-range values
    cleaned_df['flipper_length_mm'] = pd.to_numeric(cleaned_df['flipper_length_mm'], errors='coerce')
    cleaned_df = cleaned_df[(cleaned_df['flipper_length_mm'] >= 170) & (cleaned_df['flipper_length_mm'] <= 235)]
    
    return cleaned_df

def answer(df):
    cleaned_df = clean(df)
    # Group by species and sum body mass
    result = cleaned_df.groupby('species')['body_mass_g'].sum().to_dict()
    return result
